task.description: Produce design artefact(s) for 4 MUST requirements from docs/requirements.yaml (stage 16): PAR-05, PAR-06, PIN-01, PIN-02. Read the full requirement bodies directly from docs/requirements.yaml (python: yaml.safe_load, encoding utf-8-sig). PAR-05/PAR-06 continue the partitioning theme from the already-RELEASED PAR-01/PAR-04 and TESTED PAR-02/PAR-03 (this run's prior batch, WF02-batch-3-20260811) -- read those existing modules (src/event_store/store.zig, src/scheduler/partition_maintenance.zig, src/scheduler/partition_retention.zig, src/db/partition_attach.zig) for established conventions before designing new work. Classify each requirement per templates/lego-catalog.md (Type A-E). Note ISS-0670/GH-711 (PAR-02 AC5/PAR-03 AC6 event-emission gap) is OPEN and unrelated to this batch -- do not attempt to fix it here unless PAR-05/PAR-06 genuinely depend on the missing emission (check their AC text and See:/Extends: references first).
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion in PAR-05, PAR-06, PIN-01, PIN-02 bodies is covered by the design
Design is implementation-code-free (no Zig function bodies, no SQL DDL outside Type C YAML)
Design correctly builds on existing PAR-01..04 partitioning infrastructure where relevant, rather than reinventing it
Lego catalog classification applied and justified per templates/lego-catalog.md selection rules

result.summary: Design artefacts produced for PAR-05, PAR-06, PIN-01, PIN-02 (stage 16). PAR-05 (online conversion of a populated events table into a partitioned parent, Type E) and PAR-06 (time-bounded reconstruction, Type C column-addition slice + Type E bounded-query/maintenance logic) build directly on the already-RELEASED PAR-01/PAR-04 and TESTED PAR-02/PAR-03 partitioning infrastructure from this run prior batch (WF02-batch-3-20260811), reusing partition_attach.attachPartitionTimed() and DDL-04 batched-backfill discipline rather than reinventing them. PIN-01 (dependency version resolution at instance start, Type E) and PIN-02 (pin set recorded in INSTANCE_STARTED, Type E) are a distinct subsystem (PW-03, instance version pinning) unrelated to partitioning, designed against InstanceStore.create() (src/engine/instance.zig) and the existing INSTANCE_STARTED hand-rolled append path. PIN-01 surfaces two blocking dependency gaps discovered while designing against the real schema (service_catalog has no version/active-version column at all; PLC-01/module_ref does not exist yet) and documents them as explicit Open questions with a provisional stopgap rather than silently inventing schema. Confirmed ISS-0670/GH-711 (PAR-02 AC5/PAR-03 AC6 event-emission gap) is unrelated to all four requirements by reading each body and See:/Extends: list in full -- none reference PAR-02, PAR-03, or any EXECUTION_* event -- and left untouched per the handoff instructions. All artefacts pass tools/lint_design_artefact.py with 0 BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR; the one Type C YAML slice (PAR-06) passes tools/codegen_migration.py --dry-run.

issues.description: PIN-01: service_catalog (migrations/049_repository_service_catalog.sql, GBL-117) has no version/status column -- PIN-01 AC1 ("no catalog entry with an active version") and PIN-03 AC3 (DEPRECATED version status) cannot be implemented to their full text without a schema decision this design cannot make unilaterally. See src/design/pin-01-dependency-version-resolution.md Open questions #1.

PIN-01: PLC-01 (process module catalog / module_ref) is PENDING and unimplemented anywhere in src/ -- PIN-01 AC2 module-reference resolution is sequenced behind PLC-01 shipping first, not merely deferred by choice. See src/design/pin-01-dependency-version-resolution.md Open questions #2.

PAR-05: this codebase test infrastructure always re-applies the full migration set (including PAR-01 from-scratch) on fresh bpm_test provisioning, so PAR-05 online-conversion path is not reachable by a normal TestHarness-based integration test -- TEST-DESIGNER needs a bespoke pre-PAR-01-shape fixture. See src/design/par-05-online-partition-conversion.md Open questions #1/#2.
